meta.title: Dynamic Approvals: refused for a user without the Approver role
gaps: Open Dynamic Approvals and add a step or set the next approver.
Sign in as both a user without the Approver role and an Approver, then compare whether the action is refused or available.
Record tenant RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open Dynamic Approvals and add a step or set the next approver.; Sign in as both a user without the Approver role and an Approver, then compare whether the action is refused or available.; Record tenant RBAC configuration when access is granted to additional roles.

args.need: sign in as a user without the Approver role and as an Approver, open Dynamic Approvals, try adding a step or setting the next approver in both sessions, and record whether the action is refused or available and any tenant RBAC configuration

steps.note: The catalog cannot navigate to or observe Dynamic Approvals and cannot provide the two required role-specific sessions.
Provides the required final assertion after the tester completes the role comparison, although it does not assert the Dynamic Approvals outcome.
